name: Takami Rea
source: Hedonistic and freewheeling, she is a playgirl teacher with a gyaru look. Chatted during class and playing with students during breaks, she is flagged as a troublemaker in an academy full of domineering teachers. In reality, she is a slavish existence dedicated to supporting the protagonist, and it was through her behind-the-scenes maneuvering that he was able to transfer in. She aids the protagonist's activities from her position as a teacher.
